volumes.L: bare forearm, hand and fingers (1472 vertices)

idle.purpose: relaxed heavy stance: slow deep breaths lift the pauldrons, the weight rolls between the feet, a slow look around
idle.maps_to: alive, not moving, out of combat (no enemy near, no attack for 2 s; hub)

idle_combat.purpose: combat stance: planted wide, the cannon down the aim, a heavy breathing sink on the knees
idle_combat.maps_to: alive, not moving, in combat (enemies near or an attack in the last 2 s). Frame 0 is the reference pose of every upper-layer clip

walk.purpose: heavy walk: a wide rolling gait, the weight dropping onto each sabaton, the cannon swinging low
walk.maps_to: moving at under about 55 % of move speed (stick partly pushed, slows); playback rate = speed / 1.70 m/s

run.purpose: juggernaut run: low and heavy, the pelvis sinks on every footfall, the cannon held down the aim, the fist pumping
run.maps_to: moving within 45 deg of the aim at move speed; playback rate = speed / 5.6 m/s

strafe_left.purpose: side run to his left: the hips open toward the travel, the chest and the cannon kept on the aim
strafe_left.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the left of the aim; playback rate = speed / 5.6 m/s

strafe_right.purpose: side run to his right (the chest and the cannon kept on the aim)
strafe_right.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the right of the aim; playback rate = speed / 5.6 m/s

backpedal.purpose: heavy backpedal: short driving steps, the weight forward over the cannon, the cannon on the aim
backpedal.maps_to: moving more than 135 deg away from the aim; playback rate = speed / 5.6 m/s

dash.purpose: the dash burst: a low bull rush behind the anvil and both pauldrons, the cannon low and forward
dash.maps_to: the 0.16 s dash (MoverState.dash_left > 0); the client faces the hero along the dash for its duration

dash_recover.purpose: out of the dash: the lead sabaton slams down, the rear one after it, a heavy absorb on both knees
dash_recover.maps_to: the first 0.5 s after a dash ends when the hero is not moving on (else blend into locomotion)

fire_light.purpose: a cannon shot: the muzzle kicks up, the shoulder and chest take it, the weight settles back (recoil stays procedural)
fire_light.maps_to: each primary shot of a light chassis (fire_rate >= 2/s): the colossus_cannon's 2.6 shots/s

fire_heavy.purpose: a heavy shot: brace into it, the cannon bucks up and drives the shoulder back, a slow settle
fire_heavy.maps_to: a heavy / charged release (fire_rate < 1/s, charge release, splash chassis)

fire_charge.purpose: holding a charge: braced into the cannon, the fist clenched, the barrel trembling with stored power
fire_charge.maps_to: fire held on a Charge chassis (FireKind::Charge) until release (then fire_heavy)

hit_light.purpose: a flinch: the chest and pauldrons rock back, the cannon knocked off the aim, absorbed at once
hit_light.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a light hit (damage < 10 % max HP), layered over whatever plays

hit_heavy.purpose: a big stagger: rocked back, the lead sabaton steps back, a deep absorb on both knees, stepping back in
hit_heavy.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a heavy hit (damage >= 10 % max HP or a stun); interrupts upper-layer clips

knockdown.purpose: floored: rocked back off the lead foot, a stagger step back, then crashing down onto one knee, propped on the cannon
knockdown.maps_to: a knockback / launch strong enough to floor the hero (stun >= 0.8 s); holds its last frame until get_up

get_up.purpose: shoving up off the knee, the rear sabaton stamps forward under him, the lead foot resets, back into the stance

death.purpose: the fatal blow: rocked back, a knee gives and he crashes down onto it, then slumps over his knee and the cannon, a statue
death.maps_to: LifeState::Downed begins (GameEvent::Downed); holds its last frame, then downed@loop (wraith look)

downed.purpose: the wraith drift: slumped, floating off the ground, the cannon and the fist hanging, a slow heavy bob
downed.maps_to: LifeState::Downed (the Soul-Tether wraith; moves at 45 % speed with no gait, the client adds the ghost material)

revive.purpose: dragged back into the body: a jolt, the sabatons slam down, a deep crouch, up into the stance
revive.maps_to: an ally completes the Soul-Tether revive (Downed -> Alive)

reforge_in.purpose: forged anew: rises off one knee (propped on the cannon), stamps in and throws both arms wide as the seams flare
reforge_in.maps_to: LifeState::Reforging ends: the hero reappears next to an ally

victory.purpose: the roar: a crouch, then the cannon and the fist thrown up to the sky, chest out; holds the pose
victory.maps_to: the run is won (GameEvent victory / boss down, results screen); holds its last frame

ping.purpose: a ping: the left gauntlet thrusts out with the hand open, pointing ahead, the head follows

interact.purpose: work the anvil: a step in, lean over and press the plated fist down onto it, then step back
interact.maps_to: the interact input at an anvil / forge / shrine POI (PoiState use); 1.3 s

forge_hammer.purpose: hammering the anvil with the plated left fist, the cannon arm braced at his side
forge_hammer.maps_to: the forge / hub anvil upgrade (Forge screen open, hub idle at the anvil)

idle_signature.purpose: signature idle: a forge-deep breath vents the pauldron slots, he lifts the cannon to look down the barrel, flexes the fist
idle_signature.maps_to: alive and idle for 6 s or more (out of combat); in the hub and the character select

bulwark_slam.purpose: Bulwark Slam: a deep crouch, a heavy leap with both arms raised overhead, the cannon slammed down on landing
bulwark_slam.maps_to: kits.ron valdris active1 Bulwark Slam: the 7 m / 0.45 s leap runs from 'launch' to 'land' (the sim moves the entity); Nova (r 3.4) on 'land', the forge Barricade on 'barricade'

siege_stance_enter.purpose: Siege Stance: two stamping steps out into a wide low brace, the fist planted on the knee, the cannon locked on the aim
siege_stance_enter.maps_to: kits.ron valdris active2 Siege Stance cast: rooted from 'anchor' (the anchor VFX / ground glyph); then siege_stance@loop

siege_stance.purpose: the Siege Stance brace: rooted wide and low, the fist on the knee, heavy breaths, the cannon dead steady
siege_stance.maps_to: replaces idle_combat and locomotion for the 6 s Siege Stance (rooted); siege_fire layers the shots over it

siege_stance_exit.purpose: out of the brace: he straightens and steps both sabatons back in under him
siege_stance_exit.maps_to: Siege Stance ends (6 s): back to idle_combat / locomotion

siege_fire.purpose: a Siege Stance shot: a short hard kick of the cannon and the right shoulder, braced (recoil stays procedural)
siege_fire.maps_to: each shot during Siege Stance (5.7 shots/s = one per 5.3 frames), layered over siege_stance@loop; first and last frame are siege_stance frame 0

mountainfall_start.purpose: Mountainfall: gathers low, steps wide and rises with both arms flung out and up as he grows, a ground-shaking stamp
mountainfall_start.maps_to: kits.ron valdris ultimate Mountainfall cast: the x1.8 scale ramps from 'grow', the first shockwave on 'stomp'; then mountainfall@loop

mountainfall.purpose: the Mountainfall avatar stance: wider and lower, heavy slow breaths rolling the pauldrons, the cannon on the aim
mountainfall.maps_to: replaces idle_combat while Mountainfall lasts (8 s, model scale x1.8); shots and mountainfall_pound layer on top

mountainfall_pound.purpose: the Mountainfall ground pound: both arms heaved overhead, then the cannon and the fist hammered down at the ground
mountainfall_pound.maps_to: every 1.1 s during Mountainfall (33 frames = 1.1 s): the pound (r 4.5) on 'pound'; upper layer over mountainfall@loop or locomotion, first and last frame are mountainfall frame 0

armor_break.purpose: Reforged Flesh break: hunched against the blow, then the chest and both arms thrown open in a roar as the plates blast off
armor_break.maps_to: the Reforged Flesh passive when the Armor breaks: the shockwave (r 5.0) and the 3 s taunt start on 'break'; upper layer over anything
